summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark holds a big lead at -7 through 1 hole; closest chasers include Matt Fitzpatrick, Xander Schauffele, and Sam Stevens at -3.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau faces PGA Tour penalty
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau will face fines and no elite event status if he returns to the PGA Tour after his LIV contract ends in 2026.
